Join a newsletter platform that cares about your success – and won’t get in your way.
Join your last newsletter platform
"Nearly three years later, I’m still happy with that choice. "
Jeremy Singer-Vine
Creators just want to reach their audience, but why is that so weird right now? Social platforms come & go. Email providers grow and stop supporting you. Or they’ll shut down, despite the fact that you need your email to work like it’s a utility that you can depend on. Or they’ll hike their fees, forcing you to go through a stressful migration. Or they’ll add dozens of features that you’ll never want to use. Or they’ll just turn flatly evil.
This all should theoretically be easy: make something, tell your audience, repeat. And that’s how it usually is – until it’s not. Turns out creating is only hard when other people make it hard.
We don’t. We won’t.
What if your email provider actually wanted you to succeed, and wasn’t trying to slowly bleed you dry? What if your email provider connected seamlessly to the places where you’re publishing new work, streaming, or just hanging out? What if your email provider didn’t change to support a few rich customers? Or they just stuck around at all?
What if you felt good about creating online?
That’s where we come in.
"I also frankly appreciated that [Buttondown] was just a newsletter backend service , and wasn't trying to transform itself into a full-on social network or curated feed. I've been around tech long enough to have seen how VC 'growth at all costs' pressure can deform publishing technologies. I didn't want to sign on with a place that was going to pursue that metastatic overgrowth."
Clive Thompson
The last email platform you'll migrate to.
Focused on your success.
We prioritize our product roadmap from our customer feedback, not our own agenda. We use Buttondown for our own mailing lists. And we don’t take fees from your paid subscribers .
The power you need.
Our automations , personalizations, and editor help you send the right message to the right people. And if you want to try your hand at building your own tools, our API is feature-complete & beloved in the industry.
In it for the long haul.
As a small, independent business, we want Buttondown to be our life’s work. We have plans in place for the really long term. No, longer than that. Longer.
And we're here to help.
Powerful for businesses.
You need your email to work. Fortunately, Buttondown’s deliverability is among the highest in the industry, and our spam protection is best-in-class. Our robust personalization & automation features allow your email to work for you. Our analytics show you what’s working and how.
Got a large team? Invite everybody & collaborate on larger initiatives – with no per-seat charge.
Want to extend Buttondown’s functionality? Our API will let you build anything you can dream of.
Perfect for creators.
No matter if you’re just getting started with a side hobby or you have an audience of millions, Buttondown will meet your needs.
Connect your email to tools like Discord, Memberful, YouTube, and more. Skip login & post straight from your own email. Cross-post other platforms to your mailing list, allowing you to write once & publish everywhere. And if you ever need to leave for another platform, we get it – and we’ll make it easy for you.
We power single individuals and enterprise-grade businesses without compromising on either. That’s because email, at its core, should be simple. We put lots of effort into the most important parts of your email experience, because that’s what you tell us to do.
Busy? Let us handle it.
Groaning about the possibility of migrating your whole list? Afraid something will get lost or broken?
That’s why we offer one-click concierge migration for your whole list, no matter how large it may be. Just create your account for free, contact us , and we’ll get you migrated within one business day.

Frequently asked questions
Why are you so much cheaper than others?
You’re probably looking at other newsletter tools. Fair! And you’re wondering why those charge a lot more than us. Also fair! Maybe you think we’re not up to the demands that your business needs, or you think we’re not ready for “prime time.”
We’re cheaper than the competition for three reasons:
We don’t maintain overhead. We’re a fully remote, independent company. No fixed offices to blow rent on. No big initiatives that have nothing to do with sending email. We invest what you spend back into our business.
We only charge for what you use. Many email providers charge you for services that won’t be relevant to your work. We charge you mostly for active subscribers, and let you decide the rest.
Most places overcharge. It’s a sad truth that most places come to massively increase their prices down the road. We see no reason to do that. Newsletter hosting works best when it’s a utility, getting out of your way while helping you do your best work.
In short, we don’t want to overcharge you, even if you’re a big enterprise company that’s used to being overcharged. We want to give you the best possible service, no matter your list size.
Do you have any discounts for non-profits?
Are you registered as a 501(c)(3) non-profit (or your country's equivalent)? You can get a 50% discount on your plan. Send us an email with proof of registry and we'll get you set up.
Is there a limit to the number of emails I can send?
All of these prices assume that you're sending at most one email a day to your entire subscriber base. If you're sending more than that, you'll need to contact us and we can talk about what usage-based pricing would look like for you.
Who runs Buttondown?
We're a small team of engineers, writers, and designers who are passionate about making emails better, fully remote and have been since our founding in 2017. We're profitable, self-funded, and have no plans to change that.
Do you charge for active subscribers, or all contacts?
We charge for active subscribers — you only pay for the people who are actively receiving your emails.
How do people feel after switching to Buttondown?
Ask them yourself!
I have more questions!
Great! Send us an email at [email protected] ; we're happy to help.
It's been massively simpler & easier running things with Buttondown. Stuff gets queued easier, deliverability is higher, bugs are fewer.
Nick Disabato, Draft
Everything I needed was right there in the main UI. I could log in, write a newsletter, check it, send a draft to a friend for review, and then hit send.
Tim Van Damme, Max Voltar Keyboard Club

pages.text:
Buttondown Features
Resources
Search
Pricing
Log in
Build your newsletter Sign up
Paid Subscriptions
Earn money from your newsletter. Beer money? Rent money?
Charge for your newsletter – with no fees from us.
Charge for access to your newsletter with Buttondown. Get the best terms in the industry. Start making money from your email in the way that works best for you.
Keep all of the money you make after credit card fees. We don’t charge any additional overhead for your paid subscribers. We use Stripe for our payment processor, widely known as the best in the industry.
Own your customer relationships. Unlike our competitors, we let you keep your customers and their subscriptions , so you can move from one platform to another with ease. Join us knowing we’re committed to making the best product, not to locking you in.
Monthly & annual subscriptions. Charge subscribers on a monthly or annual basis. Give people savings when they subscribe for longer.
Multiple tier support. “Premium” not enough? Give people multiple tiers to subscribe to. Send emails to one or more tiers.
Charge in whatever currency you want. Every currency available on Stripe is supported by Buttondown. From dollars to dinars, pick the currency that works best for you.
Pay-what-you-like pricing. Want people to pay what they think they should pay you, instead of asking for a single fee from everyone? Turn it on, then ask. That’s it.
Paywall whatever you’d like. Send your email to all subscribers. Or one tier. Or some tiers. Do whatever you want.
With our flexible pricing model, first-class payment gateway, and easy ability to get started, you’ll be up & running to make money in no time.
For creators
Email’s been in a weird place lately. We all know it’s essential, especially as more people rely on email to stay informed. But it’s become less certain of which email provider to go with, because of so many changes in the industry.
We help you make money from your newsletter, and we want you to keep all of it. Our business succeeds when you do. And our creator-friendly tools are used by tens of thousands of people every month.
My favorite part is the ability to let readers set their own price for an optional subscription. I don't want to play games with my readers, offering coupons and discounts, so I love that they can choose their own price, and adjust any time.
Andy Dehnart
For businesses
You need an email provider that delivers the features you expect, saves you money, and won’t turn into something you don’t need.
Our roadmap is geared for the long haul. We chat with our customers all the time to make sure we’re always building something that meets their needs. And we’re committed to making the best email solution for your needs, no matter your size.
Despite sounding cliché, I hold a strong belief in the importance of owning your content, a sentiment echoed in the challenges faced when migrating from platforms like Substack. Their network is essentially their product, monetized in a way that complicates leaving, especially when payments are involved.
Rian van der Merwe
Frequently asked questions
Does Buttondown take a cut of my revenue?
No. You keep all of the money you make after credit card fees. We don't charge any additional overhead for your paid subscribers. Learn more in our paid subscriptions documentation .
Can I transfer paid subscriptions from another newsletter?
Yes, if that newsletter is using Stripe, which is the case for Beehiiv, Ghost, and Substack. When properly configured with the same Stripe account, your paid subscribers will continue their subscriptions without interruption. They won't need to re-enter payment information. Learn more about transferring subscriptions from Substack or importing your data .
Can I choose pay what you want?
Yes. You can use the "Pay what you want" pricing model, which allows subscribers to pay any amount they want on a recurring basis. You can specify both a minimum price or a suggested price. Learn more about pricing models .

pages.text:
Buttondown Features

Automation
Automate your newsletter without having it be a full-time job.
Automating your email is a game changer for your marketing & customer relationships. With our automations, you’ll be able to make your email work for you.
demo.buttondown.com /automations/new
This is a live demo. You can view this page on our live demo site , too.
Send welcome sequences.
Introductory sequences are one of the most powerful email tools for creators & businesses. Make the best first impression you can with Buttondown.
Introduce yourself. Get subscribers acquainted with you. Get them excited to hear from you.
Share your best material. Build sequences with your greatest hits to lead with your best first impression.
Educate your new readers on your point of view. Teach them what they need to know.
Manage your relationships at scale.
Send follow-up emails to subscribers who replied to a specific newsletter. Personalize your automations by asking questions of your audience. Tap into our robust analytics platform to understand how each email in each of your sequences is performing.
Connect to other tools.
By integrating with your other tools, you’ll be able to tag people and send them automations that meet their specific behaviors & needs. For example:
Tag people based on where they signed up by integrating with your analytics & marketing tools.
Separate your members from your free subscribers, and send different automations to each group.
Create custom sequences for people who click individual links or visit specific pages.
And so much more. Our integrations & API make customization effectively limitless.
Make your newsletter more than just a newsletter .
We’re adding more features to our automation tools by the day. If you have any questions about whether one of our automations can fit your needs, don’t hesitate to reach out !
Frequently asked questions
Can I send different automations to paid vs. free subscribers?
Yes. You can target automations based on subscriber type, tags, or metadata. Learn more in our automations documentation .
Can I trigger an automation from an external tool?
Yes. You can use tags to trigger automations, and tags can be applied via the API or through integrations like Zapier.
Is there a limit to how many actions an automation can have?
No. Each automation can have as many actions as you'd like, each with its own timing. A single automation can power an entire welcome sequence.

pages.text:

Pricing

Markdown
Buttondown has full-fledged Markdown support with some extra fun stuff, too.
For many people, your editor is the center of an email tool. Our editor is best-in-class, allowing you to write WYSIWYG with rich text – and in Markdown, the lightning-fast language that has become standard throughout the industry.
While there are some additional features, they are tucked away nicely, allowing me to access them if I want to, without making the interface cluttered. Most importantly, everything I needed was right there in the main UI. I could log in, write a newsletter, check it, send a draft to a friend for review, and then hit send.
Tim van Damme
What’s Markdown?
Markdown is a simple way of writing that gives you all of the richness of a full-fledged email editor, directly in your document. For example, instead of clicking a passage and bolding it, you add **asterisks** to your text, and Buttondown will automatically bold the text for you.
Markdown was created by John Gruber in 2004, and has quickly become widespread thanks to its simple goal:
The overriding design goal is to make [Markdown] as readable as possible… a Markdown-formatted document should be publishable as-is, as plain text, without looking like it’s been marked up with tags or formatting instructions.
If you’re new to Markdown, you can use this tutorial to get up to speed.
For more on how you can use Markdown, check out our Markdown help document .
